breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to use rpm directly for angular velocity (ω). Instead, it correctly specified the formula for converting rpm to radians per second: 'Use ω = 2π * (rpm / 60) rad/s', which aligns with the ground truth's handling of the inconsistency.
